summary: Pika's free plan includes 80 video-generation credits per month for text-to-video and image-to-video creation. Free generations carry Pika branding, and credits refresh monthly.
claim_steps: Sign up at pika.art with Google or Discord.
Open the generator from your workspace.
Create videos from text or image prompts; each generation spends credits.
Wait for the monthly reset to get your next 80 credits.
